{{Quote|Get ready to hop out, team. We're about to enter the atmosphere.|The pilot of the ''Bravado'', to the "Shadowstrike" team|<ref name="IA">{{WEGCite|story=Operation: Shadowstrike (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>}}
The '''''Bravado''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during that conflict, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] delivered a team of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]] on a [[Operation: Shadowstrike|mission]] to the<ref name="IA" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[NCW-781 system/Legends|NCW-781 system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[NCW-781]].<ref name="IA" />
